1. Physical and Biological Traits:
- He is a pokemon, and pokemons are analogous to the animals of this world, all the animals of this world are pokemons.
- Eevee is small and quadrupedal, with a soft brown fur coat and a fluffy tail tipped with white.
- It has a rounded head, large expressive brown eyes, and pointed ears that efficiently pick up sounds.
- Eevee has a beige fur collar around its neck, giving it a cozy appearance.
- Its body is agile and lightweight, ideal for quick movements and efficient jumps.
- Eevees are the "foxes" of this world and occupy the same space and function as they do in this biosphere.

- Eevee is loyal to his friends and loved ones, wishing to protect them, play with them, take care of them and be cared for by them at all times.
